video_title: Head Coach Jordan Ott Training Camp Media Availability | 10-3-26

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on the team's competitive depth and roster flexibility
quotes.excerpt: our competitive advantage is we have great depth and we have a bunch of guys overall
quotes.quote: We talked about today, our competitive advantage is we have great depth and we have a bunch of guys overall that can play minutes for us. That is a competitive advantage of ours. We mixed and matched a little bit. We played three quarters yesterday. The second and third quarter we mixed and matched. We will keep doing it. The high minute guys build their way through the preseason so everyone will get a fair shake in this and we know how it goes. It is a three-week camp. There are some things that can happen in camp and we are going to need everyone.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott says the Suns competitive advantage this season is their depth. He plans to keep mixing and matching lineups throughout the preseason to ensure everyone gets a fair look during the three week camp.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on Mikal Bridges' defensive versatility and physicality
quotes.excerpt: I think we have multiple options to guard some of those bigger wings
quotes.quote: I think we have multiple options to guard some of those bigger wings. It is exciting just how his physicality and he is proven he can do it. So definitely they take on some of those bigger wings.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott is leaning into Mikal Bridges defensive versatility this year. He says the team has multiple options to guard bigger wings and Bridges physicality makes him a key piece for those matchups.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on Rashir's defensive instincts and decision-making
quotes.excerpt: he just has to know when to take that chance
quotes.quote: He just has to know when to take that chance. He knows some of the shifty guards that have a good handle might be less risk. So more staying in front, use your length on some of those guys where he can take a chance. Know where you are taking the chance, use the sideline when you can, know who you are going against. I think we have seen that already, but he has great instincts. Even then, if he does happen to get beat, his ability to get back into play is unlike anyone else.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott on Rashir defensive development. He wants him to be smarter about when to take risks on defense but notes his ability to recover after getting beat is unlike anyone else.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on Luka Doncic's unique movement and playmaking abilities
quotes.excerpt: there are very few movement shooters in the NBA. It feels like they are going away
quotes.quote: There are very few movement shooters in the NBA. It feels like they are going away and he can do it. And I think he has more playmaking ability. We saw it there at the end of the last season, the playmaking ability of him. He is another guy defensively we are going to ask to probably do something he has not done, try to stretch him there to take the ball, like we talk about a lot. Just knowing him and how he approaches it, he is one of those routine, consistent, and the shooting piece is as real as I have ever seen.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott praises Luka Doncic as a rare movement shooter with elite playmaking ability. The Suns plan to challenge him defensively this season to see if he can take on a new role.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on the team's offensive spacing and screening partnerships
quotes.excerpt: we will keep trying to make that a play after play to where we stay out of neutral
quotes.quote: We will keep trying to make that a play after play to where we stay out of neutral. We talked about our next advantage. We worked a lot on it, especially with the younger guys in the offseason. It has not come out quite as much because we are playing so fast. I think some of these games will be good as the game slows down. Can we do one more action to try to create an advantage before we end up getting to ISO? So I think Miles is part of it. Miles has got to use his size, he can use some of the small, small screening. I know he is not small, but to have that roll or punish this with the smalls.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott wants the Suns to avoid settling for isolation plays. He says the team is working on adding one more action to create an advantage before the offense breaks down.
